title: Travel day: easy 30 flat, first flat running since 22 Aug
coachNotes: Travel to the coast. Thirty minutes conversational, whenever it fits, before or after the flight. THIS IS YOUR FIRST FLAT RUNNING SINCE 22 AUGUST and flat is the gradient band the ITB actually cares about, so it is a test even though it is easy. Cadence 165-170 spm from the first minute, metronome on, shorter steps at the same effort. Slightly wider step width than feels natural. Any lateral knee pain that appears during the run and worsens as it goes is a fail, walk the rest and tell me; tenderness to touch at the shockwave site is expected and is not. Remember the analgesic window: do not extend this beyond 30 minutes because it feels fine. No gym today, the hip block was yesterday.
